parakeet: A pivotal moment in my journey to atheism happened after years of wrestling with doctrine and dogma that I couldn't reconcile with reality. So at that moment I made a theological decision based on a sociological evaluation of God's obsession with what's best for humanity. It seemed to me that God was people-centric, zeroed in on really wanting the best for people. And I decided that was going to be the safe place or the safest place for me to live, to just live in a space where I wanted the best for others. In other words, in order for me to love God, I was simply just going to love people. And consequently, that led me to atheism.
